groups.P: Meta + shared language reader + input/horizon + four process groups
groups.C: target/rank identities, query_language, time routing and two Compiler blocks

design: full 2x2x2 endpoint factorial; own source video and frozen prefix, R/P4 recomputed for P; ell from P and its query projection from C; all 8 states evaluated, no outcome choosing

predictions.P_change: effect follows P after holding C/D; identifies combined reader/process contribution, not pure temporal component
predictions.C_change: effect follows C holding P/D; compiler interface functional effect
predictions.D_change: effect follows D holding P/C; decoder functional effect
predictions.interactions: mixed states worse than both endpoints implies coadaptation; cannot blame one block from a single swap
predictions.null: no success effect on train8 not exclusion of validation or other tasks; report action/functional scope honestly

limits: frozen endpoint interventions, not a historical-gradient reconstruction or a fresh architectural correction; no held gradients/Test/qualification
